title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Opera Kitsch
overview: Do we still know the grotesque when we see it? Muniz Sodré and Raquel Paiva, two of Latin America's greatest thinkers in the field of Communication and authors of the seminal book 'O Império do Grotesco', revisit their work after two decades in an opera-doc that invites reflection on the grotesque today.

title: Between Us
overview: While trying to reconnect with her ex, Maia loses her dog. They embark on a search where feelings are bound to resurface.

title: Confinement
overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

title: After Party
overview: Before they can enjoy their afterlife festivities, the prideful Jade and her timid friend Elle must realise their deadly sins while confronting their romantic feelings for one another in an eccentric underworld.

title: The Leading Role
overview: A documentary about Ukrainian actors who, when the war began, left the stage and joined the Armed Forces of Ukraine. The camera explores how creative professionals adapt to an environment where every decision carries irreversible consequences.

title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
overview: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

title: Stolen Babies
overview: Told by the mothers and children who were separated from one another, this landmark documentary reveals the full scale of the UK's forced adoption scandal. Over four decades, 250,000 unmarried mothers were forced by the British state to give up their babies. Their first-hand accounts expose the system that tore families apart, its lasting impact, and the fight to uncover the truth that led to a moment of national reckoning.

title: Assassin Within
overview: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

title: Plastic Surgery
overview: A doctor on her last day before maternity leave is thrown into a world of chaos when a hidden threat emerges.

title: Déluge mineur
overview: Joseph is looking for Mara. Mara is trying to find herself. He meets up with her at a party. People are talking about a white whale that has been washed up on the beach. Mara wants to see it, and Joseph wants to follow Mara – never mind the gathering storm.

title: Le Trésor
overview: Summer is passing peacefully at the Lake Campground. While exploring Barracuda Island, Indian and Cowboy discover an old chest filled with pirate clothes. A mysterious treasure map soon leads them on a journey fraught with pitfalls and twists and turns...

title: By Any Means
overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Onslaught
overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Desert Palms
overview: Set inside a hospital waiting room across the street from a hectic outdoor music festival, Desert Palms is a single-take live action immersive film that follows a throng of injured characters as they wait to be seen by an extremely slow and overwhelmed ER facility.

title: Sundown
overview: Joakim, a young, compassionate caregiver working in a dementia Ward, navigates the emotional toll of his work as he learns to accept the limits of his ability to help.

title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
overview: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story
overview: A Lifetime original recounting the true story of Genelle Guzman, the last survivor pulled alive from the World Trade Center ruins after 27 hours. The biographical drama chronicles her harrowing experience during the September 11 attacks and premieres on September 12, 2026, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

title: Infectious
overview: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.

title: Nevatars
overview: Aya, an aspiring artist obsessed with perfection, hides the quirky, deeply personal creations that reflect her true artistic voice inside a forgotten folder called “Nevatars.” But when her newest “perfect” character is accidentally dropped into that hidden world of discarded digital no-hopers, an unlikely escape mission forces Aya to confront the parts of herself she almost abandoned forever.

title: SEPTEMBER
overview: September 11, 2001, changed the world. But how did a single day give rise to shockwaves that continue to be felt to this day? "SEPTEMBER" retells the story of the terrorist attacks condensed into the 30 days of a month that shaped the 21st century.

title: The Rootman
overview: In the deepening twilight of the autumn forest, seven-year-old Lilly is searching for her older sister, Nora. Guided by the light of the Rootman – an enigmatic being – she encounters the mysterious inhabitants of the woods. Will Lilly find her sister?

title: The Runner
overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

title: Mayday
overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: Gandhari
overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: In the Name of Love
overview: Follows a modern-day writer who slips back in time, inhabiting the body of Wanthong from the Thai classic Khun Chang Khun Phaen, and struggles to rewrite her destiny and avoid a tragic fate.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

title: Monster Mia
overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

title: My Best Friend
overview: Facing menopause and empty-nest anxiety, friends Julia and Clara decide to travel together to visit their daughters who are on an exchange program abroad.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: I'm Game
overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

title: Al Baraneya
overview: Pregnant Amal lives together with her family in Al Baraneya, a village outside Cairo, surrounded by jasmine fields. Their chaotic yet loving way of life is upset when a landowner offers to buy their land. The pressure to sell divides the family and doubts begin to grow. When Amal’s cousin Rania visits from Cairo, she captivates Amal and her younger sisters with her modern lifestyle: jeans, TikTok videos, and lively city stories. Amal starts to question the life that seems to have been laid out for her and dreams of moving to Cairo. Now that the potential sale of the land offers the prospect of a future in the city, the family’s unshakable faith in their own life in the village starts to waver.

title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

title: Bapakmu Kiper
overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: Burgundy
overview: The story of Burgundy’s most extraordinary characters and a celebration of the pleasure that defines their lives.

title: Rock Bottom
overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

title: Pull
overview: When a young girl with lethal abilities tries to help the woman who raised her, her good intentions result in catastrophic violence.

title: Silenced
overview: After #MeToo broke the cultural silence on gender violence, international human rights lawyer Jennifer Robinson fights against the weaponization of defamation laws to silence survivors.

title: Ketticè
overview: Palermo, 2012. Giulio, a listless and dissatisfied 16-year-old, drifts through his days with no enthusiasm for school and no prospects for the future. His encounter with Ketty, a more self-assured peer, offers him an escape from the monotony.

title: O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. After a robbery gone wrong, a car ends up crashed right in the middle of the neighborhood. The driver is arrested, but the €180,000 that were stolen have vanished. Within the area sealed off by the police, rumors spread and speculations run wild. Among the residents, a whole cast of colorful characters dream of getting their hands on the loot. Who will the first to get their hands on it?

title: THE CARROT
overview: A man tries to keep a carrot alive... and fails spectacularly.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Почтальон победы
overview: Great Patriotic War. 18-year-old field postman Azamat delivers valuable cargo to the front line every day. He knows all the secret paths in the forest and in the swamp, dreams of the feat and love of the field doctor Masha. When a military plane on a secret mission crashes in the forests, Azamat alone knows how to get to the target the fastest and sneak a reconnaissance group there unnoticed.

title: Das gewisse Etwas
overview: After a jewelry heist, a father and son are on the run from the police. They find refuge in a coach full of people with disabilities who are on their way to a holiday camp in the Alpine foothills with their carer. Without further ado, they pretend to be a missing fellow passenger and his carer.

title: The Girl in the River
overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

title: Ernie & Emma
overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

title: The Incomer
overview: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: Dark Hollow
overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

title: CHAT
overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

title: Resident Dead
overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: The Kidnapping of a President
overview: In October 1930, a group of officers belonging to the Finnish army's top leadership decided, after a night of drinking, to kidnap Finland's retired first president, Ståhlberg. The Finnish people were divided in the aftermath of the civil war, and the political atmosphere was turbulent and tense. However, the kidnapping went wrong right from the start when the incompetent henchmen recruited for the job were forced to take the president's stubborn wife, Ester Ståhlberg, with them.

title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
overview: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

title: The Anchoress
overview: In the Middle Ages, a young woman pursues holy solitude in the wild -- but when a horrifying trespasser emerges from the woods, she must fight for her life.

title: Operation Cronos
overview: Based on real events, chronicles the relentless pursuit of the terrorists responsible for the horrific Barcelona attacks. With a high-stakes countdown, the film dives into the race against time from the perspective of elite state security forces, as they work tirelessly to capture those behind the tragic events in Las Ramblas on August 17, 2017.

title: Badland Rising
overview: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
overview: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
overview: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

title: Barbara Forever
overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

title: Final Transmissions
overview: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

title: Disonance
overview: A documentary about a married couple navigating life amidst financial hardship, social pressure, and family rejection. Through the choices they make, the film explores the disconnect between faith, life, and reality a disconnect that creates dissonance within them and their surrounding environment.

title: Nighthawks
overview: A young couple explores their relationship throughout three crucial moments in their lives

title: C.O.G.
overview: A pioneering tech startup is on the verge of launching COGN-AI-TIVE — a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence. Soon, the team discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own.

title: TEAL
overview: When a personal tragedy flips Blue’s world upside down, she is forced to deal with her anxiety-inducing grief by her friends, drugs, and the absurd events of one fateful night.

title: The Critique
overview: A simple surveillance gig goes sideways when two petty hustlers paid to investigate a hotel guest realize someone else has their sights set on the target. Genre:  Satire | Dark Comedy | Short-Film | Crime | Neo-Noir

title: Nightmare's Advice
overview: Lucie, a PhD student without a work visa and plagued by insomnia, is trapped in a destructive affair with her thesis advisor while being pursued by a jealous ex. Seeking help from a reclusive shaman on the city’s edge, she meets Béatrice, a young woman as carefree as she is determined to help her.

title: Celtic Utopia
overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

title: Delivery Boy
overview: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

title: Love, Rendered
overview: Follows an octogenarian couple: Burt is losing his memory; his loving wife Ethelle wants him to retain their most meaningful memories together.

title: Cuttlefish
overview: While attending his dream college, a disadvantaged boy must choose between his desire for power and his unresolved past.

title: Avec Kim
overview: After a typical day at the garage, a young mechanic swaps her stained overalls for a leather ensemble—as she shifts gears into a different kind of routine. Driving through bustling Paris, she helps a passerby cross the street, delivers plants to a hardware store, and picks up an enigmatic passenger.

title: Father Joe
overview: Set in 1990s Manhattan, the film will see Sutherland play a priest who declares a one-man war on the city’s criminal underworld. Pacino steps into the role of a powerful mob boss whose empire collides with Father Joe’s violent crusade, while Anderson plays a young woman caught between danger and redemption under the priest’s protection.

title: Cocaine
overview: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

title: Burza
overview: A devout Polish woman living in a small Mexican town endures a suffocating religious routine under her husband’s control, along with the unsettling presence of a  mysterious entity dwelling in one of the rooms.

title: Worm Regards
overview: A group of four friends are hired by the mysterious Mr. E to retrieve and deliver to him the remains of the equally mysterious Maurice Thomas Graves, resulting in many strange interactions at his café.

title: Kappa-Tiran
overview: A controversial thriller set within the shadowy, insular, and institutionally shielded world of fraternities and sororities and its banned tradition of hazing.

title: 程序乱码（DLP造梦实验室版）
Stem
overview: Inspired by a true scandal, a devoted female researcher risks everything to earn the approval of a world-renowned stem cell scientist only to uncover the dark secrets behind his miracle cure that promises to end human disability.

title: Taskmaster: GOSH Charity Special
overview: The GOSH charity special of Taskmaster

title: Invisible Injuries
overview: After war, Australian veteran Andy Fermo returned home carrying invisible wounds. Invisible Injuries explores PTSD's impact on identity, family and daily life, and the courage it takes to heal, reconnect and keep moving forward.

title: Go Home
overview: A 38-year-old single Dutch woman finds herself like a stranger in her hometown after years of working in Afghanistan with the United Nations.

title: Unleaded Wasteland
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a man is in search of gas.

title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
overview: The first ever WWE Sunday Night's Main Event takes place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, live from the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia during Labor Day weekend. The special television event streams live in the U.S. on Peacock starting at 8 p.m. ET.

title: The Mountain
overview: In the heart of the Guatemalan mountainous rainforest, a family deals with a state of slow decay. The mother is ill and is deteriorating rapidly. The father finds himself increasingly frustrated in the midst of his impotence. The teenage daughter is forced to take responsibilities beyond her age. The mountain constricts the family’s spirit until there’s nothing left.

title: Interrogation Room
overview: A film examining how power manifests itself within the confines of an everyday space.

title: SHIFT
overview: When Nina is unexpectedly asked to cover the night shift at the bar where she works, she struggles to find a way home without spending, yet again, half her pay on a taxi.

title: Until The End of Time
overview: In a world that can predict the exact moment of death, Fana, an apathetic girl with only 12 hours left to live tried to get away from the S.A.F.E. Zone (State Accomodation for Final Existence) alongside a stranger who shared the same countdown, only to rediscover her will to live just as their time runs out.

title: Runner
overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
overview: Never-before-seen footage of O.J. Simpson’s prank show reveals a desperate comeback attempt and more unsettling behind-the-scenes truths.

title: TREE HOUSE
overview: After his parents’ separation, a young boy finds comfort in his drawings of a treehouse. One night, a tear brings to life a tiny version of himself, who guides him through a dreamlike journey of reconciliation and creation.

title: Blue Danube
overview: In Lezama, fashion designer Óscar Barbosa defied the social norms of his time and environment, becoming synonymous with fashion and sexual identity. In the 1960s, he returned to his hometown with his partner, which would spark an artistic adventure that marked a before and after in the local community. "Danubio azul" is a kaleidoscope of stories that intertwine, contradict one another, and pile up to sketch the profile of a man who, over time, became a myth.

title: Flesh Impact
overview: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Lobster Film
overview: Two lobsters discuss their lives and relationship.

title: The Pickle
overview: Bob begins to spiral when he's tormented by a gross green abomination who no one else can see.

title: Dicon
overview: A hitman named Dicon breaks into a house to kill a mysterious man through the window.

title: Company
overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

title: Puca
overview: It is the early afternoon of a summer day in the 1990s. While their parents are asleep, Lotti and Malibù (nicknames the sisters use for each other) decide to sneak out to a local bar—a spot frequented by the boy they both have a crush on. Puca, the youngest, insists on coming along, threatening to wake their parents with her screaming if they refuse. The three girls set off; as they pass the beach, Puca wanders toward the water’s edge and claims to have seen a mermaid. Once at the bar, the older sisters—preoccupied with their adolescent moods—lose sight of Puca. A search ensues, leading to a confrontation that clears the air between them, followed by a fleeting glimpse of the mermaid diving and vanishing beneath the waves; that image makes them realize their childhood is gone forever. The unexpected happens when they return home to alert their parents…

title: Drawn Together
overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: The Montenegro Affair
overview: In 1951, a body is found at the Peel Bassin in Montreal. An enigmatic couple; Suzanne and Daniel; tries to get rid of two private detectives, Antonio Gratelli and Eduardo Ramirez; who suspect them of being guilty of the murder of a businessman, Maxime Montenegro.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 2
overview: The second night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 9, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: The Purgatory: The Kill Zone
overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the "Permanent Exile Law" to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Forgotten Island
overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: The Uprising
overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

title: Bad Apples
overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

title: Lion Fist
overview: Martial arts fighter Joe goes to prison for four years and takes his wife's blame for a drug bust. After his release, he learns that his son needs expensive surgery because of a life-threatening tumor. Joe's only chance to save him: a brutal all-styles tournament with a $100,000 prize.

title: SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER
overview: Every dream deserves a stage. SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER is SOOBIN’s first concert film, offering a cinematic experience with 7.1 surround sound that captures the electrifying highlights of the "ALL-ROUNDER" concert series, featuring grand-scale performances and previously unseen behind-the-scenes footage. Released to coincide with SOOBIN’s birthday, the film marks a special milestone in his artistic journey. Beyond the stage lights lies a story of pursuing dreams through hard work, pushing boundaries, and setting new standards. With the message "THE ALL-ROUNDER IS ALL AROUND YOU," SOOBIN expresses his gratitude to the audience - especially his fandom, KINGDOM - for their constant companionship and motivation along the way. Anyone, anywhere, can be an "All-Rounder."

title: Snake
overview: Paolo Marra killed his wife for no reason. Consumed by guilt, he decides to turn himself in: he wants to pay the price, serve his sentence, and restore dignity to the woman he killed—and to himself. Amid distracted police officers, zealous lawyers, fortune-tellers, and complicated bureaucratic red tape, no one takes him seriously. The man finds himself the victim of a Kafkaesque paradox: no matter how much he wants it, he cannot get himself arrested. He is the perfect scapegoat for a grotesque society that ignores those who seek redemption.

title: Mandaadi
overview: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 3
overview: The third night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 10, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: Glowurm
overview: A group of young eco-hackers infiltrates an abandoned experimental center in the Alps to document a space-time anomaly - a hidden dimension that transforms into a trap.

title: Resídua
overview: A young woman poses as a living canvas in a painter’s studio. As her body is gradually covered in paint, the silent process reveals a fragile interplay of gaze, power, desire and gradual transformation.

title: Sardar 2
overview: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

title: Jellyfish, The new Rulers of the Ocean
overview: Jellyfish blooms are making headlines around the world. This is due to the damage they cause to tourism, fishing and our health. How can these creatures, which are over 98% water and have no shell, skeleton or brain, expand so rapidly?  Although this is a normal stage in the life cycle of these gelatinous animals, we have to admit that blooms have become much more frequent and massive in recent decades. We're even witnessing jellyfish populations appearing in more and more regions where fish have been replaced by them, such as off the coast of Namibia, in the Black Sea, in the Sea of Japan and in certain areas of the Baltic Sea. What causes this? Why has the role of jellyfish in the ocean been underestimated, even though they outlived the dinosaurs? Are jellyfish on their way to dominating the oceans as they once did? What if they were to be the only ones left?

title: Norton Creek Massacre
overview: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

title: Sweet Vertigo: Now Another Enemy
overview: Six months after losing their chocolate, two young people prepare for a final mission: to reclaim what was taken from them. But upon infiltrating their old rival's lair, they discover that the craving for chocolate could have far greater consequences than they imagined.

title: Be Brave
overview: A documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary personal and entrepreneurial journey of Renzo Rosso, one of the most visionary figures in international fashion and communication. It tells this story by engaging with and utilizing artificial intelligence in a provocative and original way, placing the debate over the boundaries between human creativity and technology—and between the real and the artificial—at the heart of the film.

title: The Sunsets in the West
overview: A folk duo begins to have issues when one of them wants to leave the band and pursue music with their girlfriend instead.

title: Bad Parenting
overview: Two young brothers are left alone in a car while their dad paddleboards out at sea. When a mischievous local boy climbs into the backseat, an ordinary beach day takes a dangerous turn.

title: Viva Marília
overview: The historical, political, and social context of Brazil in the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s, and the impact of each decade on the life and work of the acclaimed actress Marília Pêra.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Epic - First Semester
overview: Rohan, a middle-class student studying abroad due to family expectations, explores romance, identity, and growing up with honesty and emotional depth.

title: Rapinoe
overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
overview: When a messy underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant, she must overcome skeptical doctors, a useless baby daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

title: A Hora
overview: On the last Christmas dinner with her friends, Laia tries to make everything go perfectly. But when she discovers that time has frozen, everything she was trying to keep under control is suspended, forcing her to confront her greatest fear.

title: Go Team!
overview: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Mighty Mary
overview: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

title: 102 Minutes: Inside the Towers
overview: Offers perspectives from survivors of the World Trade Center, timed to the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks.

title: In The Middle
overview: Four versions, one fact of matter: the search for the truth about Cinzia's story and about the underpass where she was found.

title: Don't Move
overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
overview: A poetic, emotionally expansive father-son story about Black family, grace, imagination, and the hope that love can transform even the most fragile relationships into something more healing and beautiful.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: Dahaan
overview: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

title: Tribeca 25
overview: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

title: Behind The Sins
overview: A director wanted to produce a fiction film about mining issues with local citizens, but because the story did not match reality, the local citizens decided to go home

title: Dangerous Woman
overview: A relationship is strained and eventually destroyed by power imbalance and class difference.

title: Look Back
overview: The overly confident Fujino and the shut-in Kyomoto couldn’t be more different, but a love of drawing manga brings these two small-town girls together.

title: Termite
overview: Shaunak Sen’s follow-up to the Academy Award–nominated documentary All That Breathes is an evocative drama set in the vibrant neighbourhoods of Old Delhi, where the routined lives of two middle-aged termite exterminators are about to drastically change when one of them receives an unexpected marriage proposal.

title: Drive Through Fire
overview: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

title: Haiwaan
overview: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: Last Man in Tower
overview: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

title: The Couch
overview: An aging Albanian woman becomes obsessed after her beloved couch is secretly sold.

title: Singh vs Kaur 2
overview: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

title: The Nest
overview: Marta, a woman so obsessed with protecting her family from outside danger that she decides to keep her mother and young son locked away in an isolated house high in a mountain village.

title: Morten
overview: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.

title: Mahendragiri Varahi
overview: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

title: In Alaska
overview: When a suicidal Inuk teen accidentally pierces an oil pipeline with a bullet, the FBI launches a full-scale manhunt across the northern wilderness.

title: Jayanti 2
overview: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

title: Black Sunflowers
overview: Black Sunflowers is a mosaic of Ukrainian youth, shuttling between the frontlines and civilian life, captured by the gifted American filmmaker James Marcus Haney (No Cameras Allowed) collaborating with an esteemed Ukrainian crew.

title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

title: Un renversement
overview: This film lifts the veil on the inner workings of women in politics, where everything happens far from microphones and official images. Through intimate and unfiltered testimonies from emblematic Quebec political figures, the film reveals the obstacles, struggles, and power dynamics that mark their journeys, while highlighting those who, despite resistance, forge new paths and redefine the contours of power.

title: Back to Buenos Aires
overview: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.

title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
overview: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.

title: 12 Warriors
overview: A dozen top warriors from around the world are kidnapped and forced to participate in fight-to-the-death survival games. Affairs are overseen by a disgraced and sociopathic former Russian intelligence officer who has built a shadowy organization with a clientele of crime bosses, politicians, billionaires, and members of the global elite.

title: Fanny
overview: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

title: The Delivery Girl
overview: A man's mundane life spirals into a nightmare when a food delivery girl develops a deadly obsession with him.

title: De Sidequest
overview: When Ties sets out to return Pieter’s phone charger, the short walk around the corner transforms into an unnecessarily epic fantasy quest. Joined by a bard, a wizard, and a paladin, he must survive strange encounters, unpredictable dice rolls and an adventure that grows increasingly out of control.

title: Calçada Perra
overview: A girl walks through various spaces searching for her memory through a single possession, a Polaroid picture she finds in her pockets. During her journey, she asks for help from several people who exhibit atypical behavior.

title: Designing The Dead, Feared by The Living
overview: Assigned to illustrate a male Indonesian ghost, Nina, a graphic designer, struggles to find references because most Indonesian ghosts are depicted as women. Her search leads to an Indonesian obsession with a woman ghost and news of horrific violence against women.

title: Nosebleed
overview: After trying an experimental new nasal spray to combat his hayfever, a man experiences a nosebleed with disturbing side effects.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: A recent immigrant and trophy wife from Hong Kong rediscovers her love of dance after her wealthy husband's betrayal.

title: Closing Night
overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Skavlan & Sverige - uppesittarkväll
overview: An election-eve special with *Skavlan & Sverige* – in an extended format. Guests from diverse worlds – and a host with no right to vote.

title: Almost Afraid
overview: Simon Britton, documentarian and skeptic, visits Brisbane's most haunted house to investigate reports of paranormal activity.

title: Meat Daddy
overview: Rick is nervous to meet his girlfriend Kristy's Dad for the first time. They just got engaged and he wants him to approve. But when they get to her Dad's small cattle property it's immediately obvious that things are awry - in fact Rick has just entered some kind of surreal nightmare world. Calling Kristy's Dad strange is an understatement, Kristy is acting just as bizarre, there's a creepy small boy next door in a cabaret mask, a dead tree with unsettling aura, and when Rick tries to escape he physically can't. When the weekend reaches its untimely end we then switch perspectives and see things from Kristy's Dad's point of view. Which is incredibly more bizarre.

title: Evil Genius
overview: Follows the true story of the 2003 death of Brian Wells, a notorious case known as the “collar bomb” or “pizza bomber” incident. The FBI investigation revealed an extraordinarily complex and bizarre plot, later described as one of the most intricate crimes in the Bureau’s history.

title: Spectrum is 20: The Death and Life of New Captain Scarlet
overview: Featuring new interviews with key cast and crew, and drawing on a wealth of unseen archive materials, this comprehensive retrospective explores the genesis, production and legacy of the series like never before.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: Chicken Scratch
overview: A gambling addict on the eve of eviction in NYC must embark on a wealthy stranger's quest to retrieve a plate of legendary chicken wings in exchange for his rent money.

title: Operation Hummingbird
overview: Yang Dong, a Hummingbird security officer, and his daughter are escorting Chinese nationals home when a mysterious attack shrinks the soldiers to miniature size. The tiny squad must lead the refugees to safety and uncover the truth behind it.

title: 77 Hours
overview: 77 Hours is a psychological thriller and political drama set across the nights of January 8 and 9, when Iran's streets become the scene of one of the darkest and bloodiest crackdowns in recent memory.  Unarmed and unprepared, ordinary people are trapped in chaos, gunfire, fear, and death. At the center is a man who is not a hero prepared for battle, but an ordinary person forced to survive in an inhuman catastrophe — surrounded by wounded civilians, security forces, and collapsing memories.  Through a tense, intimate narrative moving between streets, hospital corridors, hidden spaces, and broken recollections, the film explores survival, sacrifice, guilt, silence, and the fragile line between truth and fear.

title: Angh
overview: In 1960s Nagaland, a proud Konyak chief struggles to protect his dying traditions when an American missionary arrives with promises of aid that threaten his people’s identity. As his wife’s health deteriorates and famine looms, he and his mute son must make an impossible choice between survival and staying true to their ancestral ways.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: 111 Echoes from Halifax
overview: Traces the stories of characters affected by the Swissair flight 111 crash, which happened off the coast of Nova Scotia, near the entrance of Margaret’s Bay, on September 2, 1998.

title: On Horseback
overview: Early one morning, Mehmet Ali and his son Yakup set out on foot through the countryside. Although Yakup doesn't quite know where they're going or why, he tries to keep up with his father and literally follows in his footsteps. Mehmet Ali himself is rushing toward his goal, striving to achieve a result that is vital to him. However, the people they meet along the way and the events that unfold gradually lead them astray from their intended path.

title: Kick On
overview: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: Disconnected
overview: An insecure young man meeting Liliana—a girl he has been messaging for some time—in person for the first time tries to impress her by feigning confidence and self-assurance; however, his nerves lead him to make a series of blunders that ultimately expose his obsession with following seduction advice.

title: Driftwood
overview: The peaceful Toronto Islands offer comfort to two best friends after a distressing hookup, in this moving exploration of trans visibility, identity, and intimacy.

title: Bloodline
overview: Set against the systemic oppression of Chinese American communities, this elegant, spine-chilling drama follows two siblings in 1952 Utah as they search for their family's hidden treasure.

title: After Impact
overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Hyper Misao Produce ~HYPE!4~
overview: Chika Nanase trains by herself during a night at the Kanda Myōjin shrine in Tokyo, and after finishing her prayer, she finds Hyper Misao's mask on the ground in front of her. Next thing she knows, she is pulled into another world - instead of Kanda Myōjin, Nanase is now in a realm called Can Do Myōjin! Surprisingly emotional shenanigans ensue.

title: Heart of Stone
overview: Following the death of his parents, an estranged son seeks forgiveness for a mortal sin–only to draw the short end of the stick.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 5
overview: The fifth night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 15, 2026, at Hokuto City General Gymnasium in Hokuto City, Hokkaido, Japan.

title: Threaded
overview: After losing her kite, India sneaks into a mysterious palace to get it back. There she meets a mysterious seamstress and the dolls that accompany her—dolls that can talk. What India doesn’t know is that she holds in her hand the souls of all the children who were once like her and now belong to someone who seeks to prevent them from returning to their world. Will India be able to take control of her own destiny, or will she end up like all of them?

title: Homeward
overview: Some visitors descend into what appears to be a luxury bunker. There they find the end of the world.

title: Resident Evil
overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: The Weight
overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: Concerto Muerto
overview: A pianist learns what it's like to really be INSIDE his piano...

title: Apartment 7
overview: When a young woman moves into a Brooklyn apartment, chaos ensues when she unexpectedly falls for her building's superintendent.

title: Drop Dead
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: The Artists
overview: In a cold warehouse, two criminals debate their careers future over the rise of AI.

title: Alien Spa
overview: Three siblings, grieving the death of their parents, have a spa day from hell (or shall we say... from space).

title: Juan Tamariz: Amor y Magia
overview: The long-awaited film is a portrait of The Maestro, Juan Tamariz. The film is a look at magic through the lens of one of the most influential magicians alive today.

title: Shards
overview: Pavel works as a music teacher in a small provincial town. The death of his younger brother in a war zone dramatically changes his life and forces him to face a difficult moral choice. The cause lies in a depressing family secret that only he now knows.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 6
